site.title: A little world for you
site.description: A small garden to wander through, with four questions, music, and a birthday gift.

welcome.title: A little world for you
welcome.body:
There is something hidden here.
Shall we take a look?

garden.overviewHint: A few questions, tucked beside the path.

landmarks.label: The puzzle desk
landmarks.hint: Four questions and a note to keep.

landmarks.label: The music garden
landmarks.hint: Come here whenever you would like a song.

landmarks.label: The gift
landmarks.hint: A gift is waiting for you to open it.

questions.prompt: In Python, what number is the first index of a list?
questions.hint: Think of the index in items[...].

questions.prompt: In TCP, how many steps make up the handshake that opens a connection?
questions.hint: A request, a reply, and an acknowledgement.
questions.explanation: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK. Three steps establish the connection.

questions.prompt: This gate outputs 1 only when its two inputs differ. What does it output when they are the same?
questions.hint: Equal inputs take the other output.
questions.explanation: XOR outputs 0 when both inputs match.

questions.prompt: A binary signal reads 101. What number is that in decimal?
questions.hint: The place values, from left to right, are 4, 2 and 1.

music.title: A song, whenever you like
music.description:
Here are nine pieces I would like to play for you.
Choose one today, or come back whenever you feel like listening.
music.ruleText: Every draw chooses at random from all nine pieces. You may meet the same one again.
music.invitationText: When you would like to hear it, send me this card. I can record it for you, or play it when we meet.
music.copyTextTemplate: I drew No. {{id}}, “{{title}}”. When you have a moment, I would love to hear you play it.

gift.name: A passport holder & a sleep mask
gift.imageAlt: A birthday gift chosen for you
gift.lockHintWithKey: The code is on your note.
gift.lockHintWithoutKey: Four digits, from the puzzle desk.
